notes.title: Dev Log #11: August.2025
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone!  

This is the FromDawn Games team coming at you with Volume 11 of the Aeruta developer’s log!  

One blazing hot afternoon in August, while our studio was as busy as ever, suddenly—an emergency alarm rang out from our phones.
Moments later, the ground shook violently, breaking the peaceful routine of our day...

Thankfully, nothing major happened, but it definitely added an unexpected thrill to our summer! 😅
(In fact, while writing this diary, we’ve already felt two more earthquakes!)  

So between the scorching sun, the temptations of afternoon tea, the refreshing chill of cooling sprays, and surprise tremors, this summer has been full of unexpected twists. 
 
And in the middle of all that, we’ve been working hard on the game—here’s the latest update![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Enter the Underground Arena – Only the Strongest Survive! 🥊[/b][/h3][p]Cracked stone walls, heavy suffocating air, and the roar of the crowd echoing across the ruins— 
In the heart of this chaos, the Underground Arena finally opens its gates!  

Here, Chaya will face none other than the monster who reigns as the absolute champion of this deadly coliseum.  

With fists like steel, a storm of relentless combos, and the power to crush anyone who dares to challenge him...  

Yes—it’s him. 
Steel Fist Zoro!  [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/f13e294057d8e3910bb772fcb63b6bf2198d5b8a.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Discover the Truth About Patti – Befriend Them With Bread![/b] 🍞[/h3][p]After years of research, we’ve finally uncovered more about the mysterious Patti!
They’re naturally social creatures who live in herds.

But once they grow up, they leave the group to find a new home and companions of their own.

Unfortunately, reality is harsh...
Over 86% of Patti get lost on their journey.[/p][p]Accustomed to the safety of their herd, they struggle alone, hiding in the grass and enduring hunger in solitude... 😭

Brave adventurers!
This is your chance to lend a helping hand! Approach them with bread, and they’ll happily join you as loyal companions.
(And yes, they’re soft, fluffy, and delightfully squishy!)  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/893f8527b2b4a0c58a75cb08e4b855e38489d96b.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]A New Home for Patti – The Back Garden Ranch! 🎉[/b][/h3][p]“Chaya! Another Patti snuck in through the back door and ate the bread again!!!”

The once-desolate backyard of the bakery has now been transformed—thanks to Chaya’s efforts—into a Patti paradise!
(Poor Effie was too busy baking bread to take care of the garden 💦)

Raise your Patti with love, and they’ll slowly grow up, eventually helping you in adventures—or even lending a paw at the bakery!

Look forward to it![/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/a3ff98c71693682ab2f90b78ee6886a4df37368c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/9c44452135fefd48782767e924315c4f1fa80a3d.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/69c449a117ef18af52777542da185c3c18f70729.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p] [/p][h3][b]Chaya Reaches New Heights – The Final Skill Awaits! 🦊✨[/b][/h3][p]With all the adventures and bakery experience so far, Chaya’s abilities have grown in every direction.

And now, witnessing her progress, Chiva is ready to teach her the ultimate technique—
a true final skill, the culmination of everything learned so far.

Will you master nimble footwork to become a swift, agile adventurer?
Or unleash crushing strikes to carve new paths with raw power?
Or perhaps become a master of elegant, skillful combos?
The choice is yours.

Forge your path toward becoming the hero of tomorrow!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/d31235413a3a5e1ccc7476bbfc16914dbcdd1259.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]That’s all for this diary... or is it?

Everything we shared today will be available in the upcoming Steam Playtest—before the official release!

That means: 
 ・ A new map (partially unlocked) 
 ・ A brand-new boss 
 ・ The surprise-packed Patti Farm 
 ・ And the third stage of the skill tree  
All ready for you to try out early! 
(Please note: This test is only for players who already own the Early Access version.)  

This will be the last Playtest before the full release—so every bit of feedback,  
no matter how small, will help us polish the final version.  

The Playtest is coming very soon, so keep an eye on our announcements on X and Discord!    

That’s all for the eleventh development diary.   
See you all next month! 🦊💨   
[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2286780/"][/dynamiclink]X(Twitter): [dynamiclink href="https://twitter.com/Aeruta_official"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Website: [url="https://aeruta.startgravity.jp/"]https://aeruta.startgravity.jp/[/url] 
[/p][p]*All images are from in-development gameplay[/p]

notes.title: Dev Log #10: July.2025
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! 
This is the FromDawn Games team coming at you with Volume 10 of the Aeruta developer’s log!

The weather this July has been… intense.
If we’re not being toasted like burnt toast under the blazing sun, we’re getting completely soaked by sudden typhoons and torrential rain. The air is humid and sticky, and just walking a few steps feels like stepping out of a steamer… 💦

Amidst this hot and hectic month, we’ve reached a major milestone — 
the successful completion of our Rapier Playtest! 🎉

A huge thank you to all the players who joined in. 
Your feedback has been incredibly valuable and will help us refine the rapier 
so that it shines with style in the full release ⚔️✨

In this dev diary, we’ll give you a peek at our latest progress and reveal some (possibly thrilling?) new content.

And of course! We'll wrap up with the promised Q&A section to answer your burning questions!
Let’s take a look together~ 📸✨
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*][h3][b]Entering the Forbidden Zone: Unveiling the Truth...[/b][/h3]
A once-bustling town now lies in ruins.
As you delve deeper into the remains, the scenery shifts from lush greenery to landscapes corroded by decay.

What kind of catastrophe befell this forbidden land? What fate does it reveal?
Perhaps what lies ahead is a story of regret, forgotten pain, and intertwining destinies...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/09d53a166f8e0c1f620701aa2e75d640bdba1e05.jpg[/img]
[*][h3][b]Chilala's Major Breakthrough: A Brand-New Badge Appears! 💗[/b][/h3]
After rigorous testing and countless tweaks, Chilala has finally broken through her limits and crafted a brand-new, powerful badge!

Whether you're a brave brawler or a tactical controller, you’ll find new ways to build your playstyle.

Experiment freely and create a combat style all your own!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/65f908b7a30f997db44c0dae3a577b7e99ede1fc.jpg[/img]
[*][h3][b]More Inventions!? The Genius Researcher Returns! ✨[/b][/h3]
The genius Chilala, once a sensation at the capital’s academy, is back with her wild creativity! 💥

This time, she’s applying a brand-new concept to weapons themselves…
Yes — a whole new system is quietly taking shape!
(Please kindly ignore that suspicious-looking contraption for now…)

This system is still under development, but we hope it brings new surprises to your adventure. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/ae15ad00780dedd2b02a5379276383e3402986eb.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h3][b]Q&A – Round Two [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Q1：The Rapier Playtest was fun! Will there be a chance to try other bosses?[/b]

Thanks for the love! Unfortunately, the Rapier Playtest has officially wrapped up ⚔️
But our next test will be a bigger build, with much more content — stay tuned!

[*] [b]Q2：Some badges feel too powerful. Will they be adjusted?[/b]

Absolutely! We’re reviewing all the feedback and will be tuning the stats for badges and weapons.
We aim to make every playstyle fun, balanced, and full of variety!

[*][b] Q3： Will the Watersong minigame get new tracks?[/b]

We never expected the minigame to be such a hit! 😳

While our current focus is still on the main game’s development, 
we’ll seriously consider updating tracks or even adding new minigames in the future!

[*] [b]Q4：Is the "teacher" mentioned by Kocori and Tyreenss actually Effie's ancestor?[/b]

Very sharp guess — yes!
Here’s a little secret: Effie's tribe is the last surviving clan of white bears on the continent… and deeply tied to past events…

[*] [b]Q5：Will there be more new characters?[/b]

Definitely! We’re also adding quirky side characters, like the mysterious unseen postman, a powerful guild leader, and... ◯◯◯◯◯（secret for now 👀）
[/list][hr][/hr]
That wraps up this month’s dev diary!
Answering your questions was a blast — many of your perspectives were ones we hadn’t considered, and the whole team felt inspired! 😲✨

We’ve also received many questions about the full release.
While there’s still a ways to go, we’ve started our first phase of testing and are steadily moving forward.
Maybe once the summer heat dies down a bit, we’ll be ready for the next Playtest, bringing us even closer to launch! 💪

Finally, thank you again to everyone who participated in the Rapier Playtest!
We received tons of helpful survey responses — many players mentioned concerns about control complexity, unclear descriptions, and overall balance…
Don’t worry, we’re already working on these improvements! 💪🦊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/9962b208f03a89588c95a94efff61a085924d0cb.jpg[/img]
Please hang in there a bit longer — we’ll keep baking up the best breadventure yet! 🍞

That’s all for the tenth development diary. 
See you all next month! 🦊💨

notes.title: Dev Log #8: May.2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
This is the FromDawn Games team coming at you with Volume 8 of the Aeruta developer’s log!

At long last May has arrived.
The sun is shining brightly, but we are taking shelter in our nicely air-conditioned studio as we progress development and enjoy some virtual shaved ice at the Watersong Festival 🍧

This month's developer’s log may be a little late, but we’re coming back with a bang!
This time, in addition to the recent development progress, we’ll also be announcing future plans and new goals for the official release! 🍞📅

Without further ado, let’s dive in!

[hr][/hr][list]
[*][h3][b]A storm of fists is coming! Take on the forces lurking in the ruins! 🥊[/b][/h3]
Abandoned long ago and forgotten, the ancient ruins have been secretly nurturing an underground society- where your passport to entry are your bare fists. And if you can’t pack a punch, you’d best see yourself out! 🥇 
In this land wrought with injustice, Chaya challenges the current reign to the throne to a duel. No words are necessary for the truly powerful! The battle of a lifetime begins now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/495e76ccb3e29edd90e17293940e987a6d68335b.gif[/img]
[*][h3][b]An invitation to trials awaits deep in the forest🌿[/b][/h3]
Deep in Merca Forest, tucked secretly away behind overgrown vines, Chaya discovers… a hidden passage 😨⁉️ 
The moment she steps inside, the once silent forest is suddenly transformed into a battleground! There’ll be no time to rest with all the battles that await. After overcoming the barrage of foes, you may have a glimpse of some precious ingredients… Dare to delve deeper, but prepare for the strong enemies ahead with careful preparation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/b238d397c95b5d1285ccf561449bbbb8951395e3.jpg[/img]
[*][h3][b]Tourism is booming! Bakersfield is the place to be!✨[/b][/h3]
As word of the bakery's reputation spreads, the Bakersfield Plaza has become even more lively!
Bollio's architectural prowess is getting the tourists’ attention, an outpour of praise that even Bollio didn’t expect... Our little sheep was so happy inside that she spent the night busily drafting up all new designs! 📐 🐏 

Even more unique buildings, shiny tiles, and a townscape that incorporates the abundance of nature and-... what’s that-…? A new area behind the bakery!? Effie never told us about that!😱

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/19229744bc05ee43a24d7a27a60a6fb70900cd1f.gif[/img]
[*][h3][b]Experience the precise, elegant slashes of the rapier! ⚔️[/b][/h3]
Remember that blue weapon you saw at the very beginning of the game?
Well, the time has finally come to wield it! The third weapon has arrived: the rapier!

Thrust like the wind, and withdraw like a dance --
The rapier has been fine-tuned for advanced players, requiring you to be aware of your enemy’s distance and make split-second decisions!
Fill up your gauge, calculate your timing, and turn the tide of battle with a single blow!
Apply pressure head-on and switch from defense to offense!
It’s up to you to master its elegant swing…

We’re currently preparing to make it available to play for a limited time this summer! 
Please look forward to it!💪🦊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/bc69f6eda127330b215be2713410c236606c4185.gif[/img]
[/list][hr][/hr]

In other news…
May 16th of this month marked exactly one year since the launch of Aeruta in Early Access!🎉Happy Anniversary to us!

Over the past year, Aeruta has undergone several updates, including a completely new area introduced this fall, and this spring we got to get close and personal with the goddesses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/dcabf5d44291275b116076181a0dbc2940dddd2e.gif[/img]

Now, exactly six months have passed since the last major update.
Although our original plan was to deliver the official version within a year after the early access version, as we developed we realized that the content we had originally envisioned was not enough to make things as enjoyable, intense, or complete as we originally thought.

Currently, a third weapon isn’t the only thing we’re adding. Besides this, we’re adding to the main quest, new areas, implementing new systems, adjusting the UI and balance, optimizing the difficulty curve, and making improvements in many other areas.

Although game development is progressing smoothly, we still don’t want to compromise on quality. Therefore, we would like to make an important announcement.

Aeruta’s official release will take a little more time so we can take time for further refinement.

The official version is still on the way, and we promise to deliver it by the end of 2025.
We are carefully considering our plans for updates after the official release, as well as ports to other platforms, something a lot of you have been requesting.

Please wait just a little longer, we’ve got a whole lot more fun and exciting content coming!

And finally, a little heads up:
we are planning a more extensive test play before the official version is released!

We’ll be holding two rounds of tests, and we’ll be adjusting it this time around so you have even more playtime!✨

Thank you so much for all your continued support🍞🧡
As we get closer to official release, we will be focusing even more on promotions and events, so please keep an eye out for future developments! 👀

That's all for now.
See you in the next dev log!

notes.title: Dev Log #7: Apr.2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
This is the FromDawn Games team🔆

Welcome to the latest developer’s log for Aeruta!

What does April mean? 🌸
Rising temperatures, allergy season... and also our studio’s birthday month! 🍞🎉
This year, we kept developing as usual—and also kept exploding (figuratively… or maybe literally?).
We’ve poured all that joy, chaos, and caffeine into this devlog!

In this issue: nonstop explosive adventures (literally), perilous ruins to explore, a new culinary breakthrough from Effie,
and—Chaya’s life-changing moment!? 😲⁉️

Don’t miss it—let’s dive in!

[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*][h3][b]Boom Boom Boom! A New Adventure on new Island is in the Works… 💥[/b][/h3]
Suddenly—BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! Explosions echo through the ruins. 
Walls crumble, dust flies, and somewhere in the chaos—Chaya’s scream!?
Did Chaya accidentally blow something up again!? 🤯

That’s right—we’ve begun designing the third island’s stages!
With a step-up in difficulty, tougher enemies, more thrilling challenges, and huge, explosive scenes,
get your rolling pin ready—it’s time for an explosive adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/b275f127dedc565c18a5ccf23f48591f46a68686.jpg[/img]

[*][h3][b]Full of Traps and Perils—Can Chaya Make It Out Alive?[/b][/h3]
Every step Chaya takes could trigger danger… ⚠️🚨

Stay sharp and move precisely. 
Observe the remnants left by those who came before—you might just find a safe path.

Overcome each trap, conserve your strength, and prepare to face the mastermind lurking in the shadows!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/3d4ae73d7b74920ce6b4e315d470c40012dc773d.jpg[/img]

[*][h3][b]New Ingredients, New Recipes—Fresh Bread from Effie’s Kitchen! ✨[/b][/h3]
The moment Effie laid eyes on the mysterious ingredients Chaya brought back from the ruins, inspiration struck!

Fizzy sausage pie soaked in OOOO, salad buns made with XXXX, 
and cube cakes that taste like △△△△—
Chaya had no idea what any of it meant, but looking at the disaster in the kitchen, she knew…
she’d be sweeping the floor for a long time again today 🦊💦

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/5404aae602a7035198718d9702ee21f8a8486ace.jpg[/img]

[*][h3][b]Main Story Progresses—Is Chaya’s Intern Hero Journey Coming to an End!?[/b][/h3]
Who stole the Aeruta crystal? And for what reason?
Where did this conspiracy begin—and will Chaya finally become a full-fledged hero…? ⚔️

Mysteries deepen, choices grow heavier—and yes, emotions heat up too!
The main story, side quests, and affection events are now fully written—
Chaya’s path as a hero is yours to uncover! 🎮👀
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

April marks the founding of our studio—that’s right, we’re two years old now! 🎂🥳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/f4c4f11be5f36e9b1950c26e2a5dc4c321c42d2d.jpg[/img]

On April 17, 2023, we started from a tiny studio, driven by the simple belief of making games we ourselves would love to play.
We stumbled a lot along the way—but we kept moving forward.

Two years later, we’re still going strong—coding, fixing bugs, designing levels, drawing more art…
The only interruption? Watching a 15-minute preview of Mario Kart World together—
and ending the day sulking about not landing a SWITCH 2 preorder.

🎈 But what started as an ordinary day turned magical thanks to your birthday wishes! 🎉
Every message, reply, share, and review on Steam—we read them all, and they truly mean the world to us.
It’s amazing to see this space grow into a cozy home for passionate devs like us—and for players like you 💕

By the way—that mysterious new system on the roadmap? 
Development has already begun!
It’s a little surprise we can’t reveal just yet… but we hope you’ll get to see it soon ✨

That wraps up our seventh devlog. 
See you next time!

notes.title: Dev Log #6: Mar.2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
This is the FromDawn Games team🔆

Welcome to the latest developer’s log for Aeruta!

As spring blossoms, this month's minor update brings a fresh atmosphere to Bakersfield—
our two goddesses, Kocori and Tyreenss, have finally arrived, officially joining the bakery!

As their bonds with everyone deepen, long-forgotten memories and secrets—gentle, sorrowful, 
or difficult to speak of—will gradually come to light... ✨

With that in mind, let's dive into this month's development progress!
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*] [h3][b] Gifts of the Ruins—New Bread Recipes Are On the Way! 🍞🥞🥐[/b][/h3]
On the third island, ancient ruins stretch across the land, preserving traces of past civilizations. 

But beyond history, these ruins are also home to a unique ecosystem filled with rare ingredients—fragrant, rich, and exotic!

And what’s better than rare, high-quality ingredients? 
A skilled baker who can turn them into delicious new creations!

Help Effie gather these precious materials! New ingredients and new bread are coming soon—
stay tuned! 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/1c4c637e3f600c7b79393dbe0f2b5ac3a2dccd29.jpg[/img]
[*] [h3][b]The Mysterious Horned Rescuer—A New Goddess?[/b][/h3]
The enigmatic ruins are filled with danger. 
Even the most seasoned adventurers find them challenging to conquer.

Yet strangely, no adventurer has ever perished there—
because whenever they fall into danger, they miraculously reappear at the entrance.

No one has ever seen the rescuer’s true form, but rumors say they have long horns and are always accompanied by an ancient book…
Could these clues point to one of the three goddesses from the Chaos War—the legendary hero, "OOOO"? 💚

Is this long-lost hero and the mysterious rescuer the same person?
No one knows for sure, but adventurers love to speculate about the truth behind this legend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/9aebc1930be7115ee430b921d8e25d0eb7a5bbbb.jpg[/img]
[*][h3][b] A Bakery Reborn—Bigger, Better, Stronger! 💥[/b][/h3]
Do you remember Chaya’s explosive entrance when she first arrived?
Thanks to Bollio’s careful repairs (and all the money you’ve invested), Effie’s bakery is finally back to its original glory!

But why stop there? There’s always room for improvement!
Bollio has brought a brand-new catalog with adorable tables and chairs, elegant curtains, 
and high-performance ovens! 😲💕

Keep working hard to upgrade your bakery and save up for renovations! Let’s aim to become the world’s No.1 super bakery! 🏆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/a74045e176d86b34be436a522e918fdaab8bc27a.jpg[/img]
[*][h3][b]The Ultimate Mastery—Weapon Skills Phase 3 Incoming![/b][/h3]
That’s right—Weapon Skills Phase 3 is now complete!

In this new phase, whips, rolling pins, and rapiers will receive powerful enhancements!
Each weapon type will unlock its own exclusive third-stage upgrade—
Imagine XXXX soaring through the air, △△△△ striking from above, and □□□□ bursting with radiant colors!

We hope this expanded skill tree will bring even more thrilling combat experiences!
Get ready to harness new powers and take on even greater challenges! 👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/bbb3a14ba14871bdf253d84214c704b4ef3c7afd.jpg[/img]
[/list][hr][/hr]

Thank you all for your support, making the spring update rollout a success! 
Have you met the goddesses yet?

With the spring update now stable, we will continue refining the gameplay experience—fixing translation errors, adjusting level designs, and polishing details to further enhance the game.

At the same time, there won’t be any major changes following this spring update—
because we are now fully diving into the final development sprint for the full release of Aeruta🏃

Though there’s still some time before the official release, our team is steadily making progress.
With our spirits and determination burning strong, we’ll keep pushing forward! 💪🦊

Moving forward, we’ll continue sharing updates through these dev logs, bringing you the latest news.
With your support, Chaya’s adventure has come this far—let’s march toward the full release of Aeruta together! 🌼

See you in the next dev log!

notes.title: Dev Log #5: Feb.2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This is the FromDawn Games team🔆

Welcome to the latest developer’s log for Aeruta!

After the holiday break, we jumped straight back into development, working on both the upcoming spring update and new content. We almost ran out of time to write the February dev log… 🙇💦

Thank you for your patience! Without further ado, let’s dive into this month’s progress!! 
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*] [h3][b]The Goddesses Have Arrived—Welcome to Bakersfield! 💙❤[/b][/h3]
Let’s give a warm round of applause (and some excited screams) for the hero among heroes—
our divine goddesses!

Kocori and Tyreenss have officially arrived in Bakersfield! 
(Though Kocori has been sneaking around for a while…)

The approachable and friendly Kocori, the cold yet dignified Tyreenss—how will they interact with the other residents? 
What kind of story will unfold between them and Chaya?

Find out in the March mini-update as you search for these divine figures in Bakersfield Plaza!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/e8943b187a721696cdddb60b42f998f173f332f8.jpg[/img] 
[*] [h3][b]In the Ancient Ruins Lies a Hidden Truth…[/b][/h3]
Let’s take a sneak peek at the development of contents for the full release!

Chaya's next adventure is to an ancient ruin abandoned long ago. 
Once a thriving city, it was tragically destroyed from war. 
Now moss, ivy, and mushrooms have overgrown and covered the walls and ground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/8d241fd070ecacabef4da395ad2f49557053581b.jpg[/img] 
Wait a second… did you hear that low growl in the wind…? 
Have these ruins truly been abandoned? 
Or is someone secretly watching intruders?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/1167a6822e3e4a9dff262e9b3bbef5ccd445f3d9.jpg[/img] 
[*][h3][b]New Weapon in Development: The Rapier![/b][/h3]
You’re not gonna want to miss this! Aspiring heroes, get ready to wield the third weapon—
the rapier! (We’re not stealing it, just borrowing!)

The rapier is a thin, razor-sharp blade as swift as the rising crescent moon and as elegant as the full moon’s glow. Designed for rapid thrusts and precision attacks, 

it’s the perfect weapon for those who want to push their speed and skill to the limit! ⚔️✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/5b3301712e5d530586e18f1bdc6048902552007d.jpg[/img] 
[*][h3][b]New Feature: Q&A Corner![/b][/h3]
We often see bug reports and questions from the community on social media and the Steam forums.

However, due to our workload and language limitations, we haven’t always been able to respond to everyone individually…

So! To better address your concerns, we’re launching a Q&A Corner! 

Here, we’ll compile and answer some of the most frequently asked questions:
[olist]
[*][b][u]Will there be an achievement system in the future?[/u][/b]
👉 Yes! Please look forward to it!
[*][b][u]Will there be additional stage modes?[/u][/b]
👉 Yes! New stage modes will be added in the full release. We hope you’ll look forward to it!
[*][b][u]The difficulty of Chapter 2 spikes suddenly—is this intentional?[/u][/b]
👉 We’ve adjusted some adventure stages and hope to improve this in the upcoming spring update!
[*][b][u]What species are the villagers introduced in the autumn update?[/u][/b]
👉 Guinea pigs! Most of them work under Tyreenss, though having a workaholic boss is… 
a bit stressful for them (lol)
[*][b][u]Will new songs be added to the rhythm game?[/u][/b]
👉 Our focus is currently on developing new content, but we’ll definitely consider it!
[/olist][/list]

Overwhelmingly, the question we received more than any other was: “When will the game officially release?”

At this time, we are still in the midst of development, so we don’t have a complete view of the development schedule just now.

We will keep you guys updated on the progress in our dev logs, so please look forward to further updates!

Phew~ that’s it for our Q&A Corner. We’ll continue updating it along with the dev logs, so stay tuned! 🌻

If you have any concerns or questions, please let us know in the dev log comments or in the comments on our social media!

Last but not least, looking back at January, we wrapped up the Taipei Game Show on a high note and returned from the New Year holidays refreshed and motivated.

Offline events like these are rare and valuable opportunities—not only do we get to hear your feedback firsthand, but we also get to witness players enjoying Aeruta in person. Some of you even visited us just to share your excitement about the game—it was truly an unforgettable experience! 🥺🧡

And as for the merchandise that many of you have been asking for… we want to make it too!
Bread-shaped sponges, Patti figurines, real-life bread replicas… Just imagining it all is so exciting!

But for now, ensuring Aeruta is at its best quality is our main goal! 🦊👍
So please wait a little bit longer for goods! ✨

That’s all for this issue of the Aeruta Dev Log! We’ll see you all again in March!

How did the cheerful and bright Kocori and the stern yet calm Tyreenss become goddesses?
Strengthen your bonds with them and all will be revealed!💙❤

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/39fbb7d039355c968493fe92151df1e760031f38.jpg[/img] 
[*] [h3][b]New area incoming! Our next destination is…[/b][/h3]
Following Chaya’s adventures in Merca and Orrindae, our hero will travel to the next stage: ancient and bustling ruins.
It will be a stage full of ●●●●●, ×××××, and plenty of △△△△△!
It’s sure to be a new and exciting experience, with even more dangers and delicious attractions! 

The whole team is currently hard at work designing all the new environments, enemies, and ingredients. We’re really looking forward to sharing it with all of you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/88b698a3929fdbb0168a4da22d72e9f734f9bed4.jpg[/img]
[*][h3][b]The 1st Character Popularity Ranking: Bakersfield Cup![/b][/h3]
During the Steam Playtest held November last year, we compiled and ranked your favorite characters from the survey🏆

So let’s take a look at who captured everyone's hearts in the 1st Character Popularity Ranking <Bakersfield Cup>!
🎉

🥉 3rd place: Chilala
Despite her late appearance in the game after the fall major update, her adorable appearance and remarkable genius (and numerous eccentricities) garnered her a lot of attention, rightfully earning her third place!
It seems many were charmed by this young genius!🎀

🥈 2nd place: Effie
You can't go on an adventure without a loaf of Effie’s bread!
The kid bear who always supports Chaya and friends in their adventures ranked second place!
Effie lost her parents when she was a small child, but inherited the family bakery. Thanks to her inner strength and natural cheerfulness, she diligently continues to research new bread recipes.
The warm loaves of bread she makes are as soft and comforting as hot cocoa with marshmallows on a winter day!☕️

🏆 1st place: Chaya
The winner is none other than the main character of our story, thanks to the overwhelming support of everyone who voted!
As a rookie adventurer she may be a little out of her element now and then, but her positive and kind nature as well as her courage in the face of difficulty proves her potential to be a hero (though she’s not quite there yet)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/8f3e268247b81dbb6f41bfdbf584a2baf976d3e5.png[/img]
Did your fav make the rankings?

notes.title: Dev Log #3: Dec.2024
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is the Aeruta development team🔆
Welcome to Volume 3 of the Aeruta Dev Log!

Following the Fall Major Update in November, have you all gotten into the “rhythm” of kneading bread dough? 🥖

Just as we sow seeds in the spring and harvest them in the fall, we had finally reached the time to welcome our first major update, exactly six months after releasing early access!

Sorry for the long wait, but how about we take a quick look back at everything the fall update 
brought us🍁
[hr][/hr]
[h3]◾ Holding a Steam Playtest before the official Fall Major Update![/h3]
Prior to the big update, we held a Steam Playtest for three days to collect all your valuable feedback.
We were overjoyed to receive a total of 114 completed surveys!

These surveys were filled with valuable opinions, creative ideas, tons of encouragement, 
and most importantly, real impressions of the gameplay experience. 
Some of you gave us such in-depth analysis it was like reading a graduation thesis 📝

Additionally, many people actively shared bug reports and insights on Discord. 
It was thanks to the help of all of these people that we were able to make our Fall Major Update 
even better! ✨

We had also received some feedback that the Playtest was too short! We’d like to let you all know we’re sorry for that and we’ll be more considerate next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/2d43ae04c7ed343b2d847b732d8252e866217737.jpg[/img]
[h3]◾ As the harvest season begins, a major update is ready🍁 [/h3]
Looking back, we are amazed at the incredible reception of the update😲
Following the update, the total number of reviews we received from you on Steam exceeded 350 
and the “Recent Reviews” reached 98%, so we are very happy that so many of you enjoyed the update!

To celebrate this delightful achievement, we held a big celebration in the studio, ordering fried chicken for the whole team for the first time in a long time 🍗✨

Let's take a look at all the wonderful things that happened, shall we!

🦊 Maintained user ratings at “Very Positive” and increased the favorability rate from 87% to 89%
🦊 More than 400 people added Teddy Bread to their wish list every day
🦊 Over 600 people were fighting to pay off their debt in Bakersfield daily

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/a4faaeae965f4abebe3e7c141a1ef1a43101604a.jpg[/img]
[h3]◾ Further changes based on your feedback![/h3]
In addition to the planned contents such as the second island, new characters, 
and raising the level cap for various systems, we made various changes based on your feedback 
in this update.

Here’s an overview of the changes we made!

🍞 NPC elements (additional conversation variations, gifts, friendship system, meeting characters during adventures)
🍞 Added “Patti Defense Battle,” a stage great for collecting lots of patti dough!
🍞 Addition of icon to notify completion of skill cooldowns
🍞 Addition of numerical display of materials in your possession in the stage selection map UI
🍞 Added window resolution options for various ratios

Besides this, many other design adjustments and improvements were also made thanks to your valuable feedback.

Thank you all so much! 🌏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/087da1ae4f8ac2e2bf4cb89586b18a7cc3521361.jpg[/img]
[h3]◾ Development plans for 2025 are now available![/h3]
Following the adventures on the second island, even more trials await on Chaya’s road to heroism…
The Aeruta Crystal has been stolen by a mysterious black mist, and the Adventurer's Guild has a conflict with the goddesses.

Will Chaya successfully pass the Adventurer’s test and graduate from being a rookie adventurer?

💥[b] All will be revealed come 2025! [/b]💥.

Around next spring, we plan to add friendship events for the goddesses! Get ready to conquer their hearts! 

And what’s more, we plan to implement a third island by the end of 2025. 
Not only will a third weapon option be made available, but a very interesting system is also 
in the works…

There’s so much to look forward to✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/59a3d831b014cdd3b6d0523c122a0230df687351.jpg[/img]
November was full of busy days preparing for the major update, so unfortunately the development diary took a temporary break... but during this period, preparations were well underway behind the scenes!
When it finally comes time to pick up the pen, it's pretty hard to know where to start talking, though.

We wanted to share with you all the feelings of joy and gratitude we’ve felt, behind-the-scenes development stories, trivia, our personal thoughts on Aeruta, and answer some of your survey questions…

We really had so much more we wanted to tell you, but we’ll be sharing even more in the future🌻

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/7ea9a601da15954f11e5207691eb4b815f6776b3.jpg[/img]
With the little bit of 2024 that remains, a few weeks ago we took our rolling pins to the G-eight gaming exhibition in Taiwan. There was an adventurer at the event who breathed a sigh of relief after defeating Birdy Captain then turned to us and said, “I've been so busy with work before New Year's Eve I haven't had time to play the updated content at all...'

Thank you all so much for your hard work TT…
Effie's Bakery will always be here for you!

May 2025 be a year filled with strength, willpower, and good luck for all of you! ✨
We will continue to improve on our shortcomings and produce an even better game, so look forward to more surprises in the future!

Let's do our best together in the new year! 🦊🍞

notes.title: Dev Log #1: Sept. 2024
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This is the Aeruta Development Team🔆

Welcome to our first official development log!

It’s been a little while since Aeruta’s Early Access release, but we wanted to check in and let you know the team has been hard at work everyday preparing future updates as well as getting ready for Aeruta’s official release.

To keep you all in the loop, we decided to start a development log so you can see the progress we’ve been making and take a look at what we’re adding in the future!

This is our first time doing something like this, but we’re excited to receive all your feedback and thoughts as we continue to release these updates.
So without further ado, let’s dive into the world of Aeruta!
[list]
[*][h3]Free Update for Fall🍁[/h3]
As August came to a close, we said farewell to summer days (even though we’re melting from the heat as we’re writing this…)
The end of summer means the start of the fall season and with it a brand new free update to enjoy.

Due to the variable nature of game development, we can’t share too many details just yet. But rest assured that you can look forward to the update sometime in November.
We’re really looking forward to sharing it with you all very soon!
[*][h3]2nd Stage Design Details[/h3]
We’re happy to announce that the “Second Island” you’ve all been looking forward to is currently in the late stages of production!
This island has three different environments, each being inspired by the “aroma” of bread.
The stages incorporate the fresh aroma of fruit and the intense smell of flowers to create a tropical island atmosphere!

As you venture deep into the dungeons, you’ll encounter all new and extremely dangerous obstacles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/5ba2eddcd88bb52c429fdf6f037bf0671f1b1766.jpg[/img]
A variety of enemies await you on the island including members of a small bird militia, smoke-scented Pattis, and three new bosses. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/1d123951c7918cc313bcfc3ee74767f980942ccf.jpg[/img]
[*] [h3]New Resources and New Breads[/h3]
There are two things that Effie looks forward to the most: Chaya’s safe return from her adventures, and the new ingredients she brings back! After all… you can't make bread without the ingredients, right?
With the bounty of ingredients Chaya brings combined with the recipes Effie inherited, research for the new breads has already been completed!
Here’s a little sample of the breads made with tropical island flavors!
Stay tuned for other breads in the upcoming fall update.🍞🥐
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/513cd7cd5941f969aa5cfa0aa53d28b36b4a9bb1.jpg[/img]
[*][h3]Progress the Main Storyline![/h3]
Chaya’s journey to becoming a hero, the epic oven disaster that led her into debt, and a mystery lurking in the shadows… we can only guess what turns this tale will take with the addition of two all-new characters in Bakersfield!
But this is as far as we’ll go with spoilers! Don’t worry, you’ll have the chance to enjoy all the details in the update coming soon!

Right now, the team is working on stories for each character that you can delve into. Which character are you most interested in getting to know?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/96fc7a8e2cd1e6453ab991cc4734fc8214ea9536.jpg[/img]
[/list]
And that’s all for the news regarding the fall update!

But that wasn’t the only thing we planned to announce… we’ve got one more big announcement for you!
And that big announcement is… all the content we just shared will be available to experience at the upcoming Tokyo Game Show 2024!!!
This will be an exclusive, early look at everything coming to the new island! If you’re coming to the Tokyo Game Show, be sure to stop by our booth and get a sneak peek!
On top of this exciting news, we’ve got tons of free goodies to hand out to everyone who plays Aeruta at the event, including some limited-edition notebooks and stickers!
You won’t want to miss this chance.✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/1cc9207bece2486ae8568df77dcaace56a22d487.png[/img]

To wrap up this dev log, we’d like to give a final thank you to all of you wonderful players who went out of your way to purchase the Early Access version of Aeruta.
Thanks to your support and feedback we’ve been able to get a clear understanding of where improvements need to be made and work towards creating the most balanced version of Aeruta for final release.

Besides the upcoming fall update, the whole Aeruta Team will continue to do their best to think of even more adventures and research a variety of bakery management strategies.

Each upcoming development log will be an exclusive development to the tale of Bakersfield, so don’t miss an update!
To keep up with the latest Aeruta news, be sure to follow our official X, Discord, and Facebook accounts🦊🍞

That’s all for this edition of Aeruta’s development log.
Thanks for reading all the way to the end!

notes.title: This demo has it all: anime girl brawling and bakery management
notes.notes:
As far as bread goes, I'd say those unlimited top-ups you get with fancy meals can sometimes supersede the actual meal itself. A little swirl in olive oil and balsamic? Mwah, delicious. For a more regular transaction, I do love a multi-seeded loaf for the added texture. Now, would I say I like bread more than… anime? That's tough. But thankfully I don't need to decide, as there's a demo of a game out right now that combines both interests. In Aeruta you play as an anime girl who defeats monsters and uses their innards to fuel her bakery business. Perfect.
